content: .{@-श्लोक@} {%a.%} ‘well-spoken of’, or ‘auspicious to repeat or utter the name of’, of good fame; <ls>Dk. 2. 8</ls>. . ({@-कः@}) an epithet of Nala (of Niṣadha); Yudhiṣṭhira and Janārdana; पुण्यश्लोको नलो राजा पुण्यश्लोको युधिष्ठिरः . पुण्यश्लोका च वैदेही पुण्यश्लोको जनार्दनः ... . ({@-का@}) an epithet of Śītā and Draupadī.
